title: Giygas Sand
description: Turns soul sand into Giygas from Earthbound
body:
## IGNORE THE TEXTURE WARNING, THE TEXTURE PACK WORKS ON MOST VERSIONS!

**Turns Soul Sand and Soul Soil into Giygas From earth bound, also makes Soul Torches, Campfires and Lanterns red (like giygas).**

Souls Sand is the phase 2 Giygas texture and Soul Soil is Phase 3

Enjoy this very niche mod!
